<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="1GRRybDqJBBdNpgi3X3V" name="第 1 页"> <mxGraphModel dx="1867" dy="1008" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD
 Start([\"用户敲击键盘输入命令\"])
 Keyboard[\"按键中断 → keyboard_interrupt → do_keyboard_interrupt\"]
 TTYRead[\"tty 驱动 put_queue + wake_up 唤醒 Shell\"]
 ShellRead[\"Shell 通过 read(0) 逐字符读取输入\"]
 Parse[\"Shell 解析命令行：ls -l | grep ^d > output.txt\"]

 CreatePipe[\"调用 pipe() → sys_pipe<br/>get_pipe_inode 创建管道 inode<br/>分配环形缓冲区, 返回 fds[0]=3, fds[1]=4\"]

 ForkLs[\"fork() 创建 ls 子进程<br/>sys_fork → find_empty_process → copy_process<br/>copy_page_tables 建立 COW<br/>子进程继承 fd\"]
 ForkGrep[\"fork() 创建 grep 子进程<br/>同上 copy_process + COW<br/>子进程继承 fd\"]

 ParentClose[\"父进程 close(3), close(4)<br/>管道 inode i_count 仍为 2\"]

 LsStart[\"ls 子进程被调度 (TASK_RUNNING, eax=0)\"]
 GrepStart[\"grep 子进程被调度 (TASK_RUNNING, eax=0)\"]

 LsDup[\"dup2(4,1) → sys_dup2<br/>stdout 重定向到管道写端\"]
 LsExec[\"execve('/bin/ls') → do_execve<br/>namei 打开文件<br/>flush_old_exec 释放旧页表<br/>change_ldt, do_mmap 建立虚拟映射<br/>create_tables 构造栈, 设置 eip, esp\"]

 LsPageFault[\"首次执行触发缺页异常 #PF<br/>_page_fault → do_no_page<br/>get_empty_page 分配物理页<br/>read_page → bread → ll_rw_block(READ)<br/>wait_on_buffer 睡眠<br/>磁盘中断 hd_interrupt → end_request 唤醒<br/>put_page 设置 Present=1\"]

 LsOpen[\"open('.') → sys_open → namei 获取目录 inode\"]
 LsLoop[\"循环遍历目录项\"]
 LsGetdents[\"getdents/read → minix_dir_read<br/>bread 读取目录块, 解析 minix_dir_entry\"]
 LsStat[\"stat(filename) → sys_stat → namei → cp_stat<br/>获取文件属性\"]
 LsFormat[\"格式化输出字符串\"]
 LsWrite[\"write(1) → pipe_write\"]

 PipeWrite{\"管道缓冲区满?\"}
 LsSleep[\"interruptible_sleep_on → schedule()<br/>ls 进入 TASK_INTERRUPTIBLE 睡眠\"]
 LsCopy[\"将数据写入环形缓冲区<br/>更新 PIPE_HEAD<br/>wake_up 唤醒 grep\"]

 GrepOpen[\"open('output.txt', O_CREAT|O_TRUNC)<br/>sys_open → open_namei<br/>new_inode / alloc_block 分配 inode 和数据块<br/>返回 fd=3\"]
 GrepDup[\"dup2(4,0) → sys_dup2<br/>stdin 重定向到管道读端<br/>dup2(3,1) → sys_dup2<br/>stdout 重定向到 output.txt<br/>close(3)\"]
 GrepExec[\"execve('/bin/grep') → do_execve<br/>类似 ls 的 flush_old_exec, do_mmap, create_tables\"]
 GrepPageFault[\"缺页异常 do_no_page 加载 grep 代码\"]
 GrepRegcomp[\"regcomp('^d') 编译正则表达式\"]

 GrepLoop[\"循环 fgets(0) → read(0) → pipe_read\"]
 PipeRead{\"管道缓冲区空?\"}
 GrepSleep[\"interruptible_sleep_on → schedule()<br/>grep 进入 TASK_INTERRUPTIBLE 睡眠\"]
 GrepCopy[\"从环形缓冲区取数据<br/>更新 PIPE_TAIL<br/>wake_up 唤醒 ls\"]

 GrepRegexec[\"regexec 执行匹配\"]
 Match{\"匹配成功?\"}
 GrepWrite[\"fputs(stdout) → write(1) → file_write<br/>bread / alloc_block 写数据到缓冲区<br/>标记 b_dirt\"]

 LsExit[\"ls 完成, exit() → do_exit<br/>free_page_tables, sys_close 关闭管道写端<br/>i_count 降为 1, 发送 SIGCHLD<br/>状态变为 TASK_ZOMBIE\"]
 GrepExit[\"grep 读到 EOF, exit() → do_exit<br/>free_page_tables, 关闭管道读端<br/>i_count 降为 0, 释放管道缓冲区页<br/>关闭 output.txt, 写回脏块<br/>发送 SIGCHLD, 变为 TASK_ZOMBIE\"]

 Waitpid[\"Shell 调用 waitpid() → sys_waitpid<br/>循环查找 ZOMBIE 子进程<br/>free_page 释放 task_struct 和内核栈\"]

 Prompt[\"Shell 输出提示符<br/>write(2) → tty_write → con_write<br/>写入显存 0xB8000\"]

 Start --> Keyboard --> TTYRead --> ShellRead --> Parse
 Parse --> CreatePipe
 CreatePipe --> ForkLs
 ForkLs --> ForkGrep
 ForkGrep --> ParentClose

 ForkLs --> LsStart
 ForkGrep --> GrepStart

 LsStart --> LsDup --> LsExec --> LsPageFault --> LsOpen --> LsLoop
 LsLoop --> LsGetdents --> LsStat --> LsLoop
 LsLoop -->|\"遍历完成\"| LsFormat --> LsWrite --> PipeWrite

 PipeWrite -->|\"否\"| LsCopy
 PipeWrite -->|\"是\"| LsSleep --> LsCopy
 LsCopy --> PipeWrite

 GrepStart --> GrepOpen --> GrepDup --> GrepExec --> GrepPageFault --> GrepRegcomp --> GrepLoop
 GrepLoop --> PipeRead
 PipeRead -->|\"否\"| GrepCopy
 PipeRead -->|\"是\"| GrepSleep --> GrepCopy
 GrepCopy --> GrepRegexec --> Match
 Match -->|\"是\"| GrepWrite --> GrepLoop
 Match -->|\"否\"| GrepLoop

 GrepLoop -->|\"EOF\"| GrepExit
 LsCopy -->|\"数据写完\"| LsExit

 LsExit --> Waitpid
 GrepExit --> Waitpid

 Waitpid --> Prompt
